critical_code_review_comments: kb.py /kb/save-from-investigation returns 400 for both invalid ObjectId and 'not found' — arguably 'not found' should be 404. Currently matches the review request assertion ('HTTP 400 with invalid or not found detail') so acceptable.
builder._load_user_history caps at 500 for auto-cluster sibling gathering; investigations with >500 history rows could miss siblings in a saturated bucket. Acceptable trade-off but worth documenting.
ChainReplayView.jsx uses api.post('/kb/save-from-investigation', ...) with synth=true (matches spec). Success/error states covered, in-flight disable works, testids all present.
Fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task in history.py is silent on task exceptions — consider adding a wrapper that logs task failures so bad KB clustering doesn't fail invisibly.
